rewrite: The rules requiring relocation assistance and a filing with the Los Angeles Housing Department (LAHD) for no-fault evictions under the Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO) and Just Cause Ordinance (JCO) would apply to this address, but they are not in effect yet and start on 2026-07-01. Source: LAMC 151.09.A.8-14, 165.03.H-M, 165.06, 151.30, 47.06-47.07; RAC Regulations 960.00; as of 2026-01-02. Not legal advice.
